sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Find the Manila Room. Remaining inside it long enough will take you to the next level.

sections.heading: Controls
items: WASD or arrow keys: move
Mouse: look around
Shift: run
Space: jump over low obstacles
E: open info and inventory
Esc: pause, or close the current menu

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Find the exit through the garage while avoiding hazards and entities.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Pick up the torch near the start if you do not already have it.
False puddles are dangerous if you step too close.
Hounds can be delayed by pointing the equipped torch at them.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Move through the maintenance tunnels and find the documented exit.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Smilers linger on wall faces in dark areas. Do not get too close and do not shine the torch at them.
Deathmoths roam the tunnels and are attracted to active light sources.
Some low obstacles can be jumped over with Space.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Navigate the long industrial hallways and find one of the elevators leading deeper into the complex.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Level 3 is larger, darker, and louder than the previous levels, so plan retreats before moving into long corridors.
Fume vents can activate without warning. Move away from leaking pipes quickly to avoid taking damage.
Ceiling heat zones glow before they become dangerous, but once active they remain hot for a long time.
Hounds roam this level and can be slowed by pointing the equipped torch at them.
Smilers appear on wall faces in dark areas. Keep your distance and avoid shining the torch at them.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Search the abandoned office floor for an office stairwell or elevator exit.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Level 4 is safer than the industrial levels, but it is still not harmless.
Almond Water bottles can be picked up and consumed from the inventory to restore health.
Most blacked-out windows are only unsettling. Uncovered windows are traps and will pull at you if you stand too close.
Hounds are rare here, but the open office corridors make it easy to be seen from farther away.
Use this level to recover before moving on.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Move through the hotel corridors, lobbies, and side rooms to find the exit toward the next level.

sections.heading: Survival
items: The hotel halls are cleaner and brighter than they should be. Do not let the furniture and music make you stop moving.
Deathmoths nest throughout Level 5 and are more common here than in earlier levels.
Large lobbies are easier to scan, but long hallways expose you from far away.
Almond Water can still be found in rooms and public areas.
The torch helps with hounds, but active light can attract deathmoths.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Move through the dark maze and find the exit. The torch will not pierce this level.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Ambient pulses occasionally reveal enough of the maze to choose a direction.
Move carefully. Low wire traps are almost invisible until you are near them.
The level is navigable, but visibility is intentionally unreliable. Listen, count turns, and use the pulse flashes to keep direction.
Classification 5 means this level is meant to feel hostile even without visible entities.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Leave the entrance room, cross the cold ocean, and find the pipe-ring exit platform.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Open water slows movement and gradually causes cold exposure damage.
Rock islands and the exit platform let you recover from the cold.
Bones and pipe markers indicate you are moving into more dangerous water.
Keep trips away from the entrance short unless you can see the next safe island.
